evidence: HPO-borrowed disease factors reach **0.4586 / 0.5388** on disease cold start, against **0.2245 / 0.1972** for raw HPO features and **0.1709 / 0.1718** for the base histogram.
metric: base 0.1709 / 0.1718; raw HPO 0.2245 / 0.1972; HPO-borrowed IDF-SVD 0.4586 / 0.5388; 1,919 diseases; 83 held out; 4,773 eval pairs; 412 HPO-covered diseases; 245 covered targets; base rate 0.1726
observation: Held-out diseases have no training target-disease edges and almost no intrinsic content. Ancestor-closed HPO features and HPO-similarity borrowing of disease SVD factors were tested on 83 held-out diseases; borrowed factors roughly doubled the raw-ontology score and beat both the base histogram and the target-degree control.
subject: F-53
title: Disease cold start: raw HPO helps, HPO-borrowed SVD factors help much more
